_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by month decorated with a SERIES OVERLAY_FORMULA: one expr-lang expression evaluated per month against the SERIES namespace — value (the scored aggregation), total (the sum over every month), prior (the previous present month; null on the first) and baseline (the month at params.baseline_position, 0-based). Here: month-over-month change as a share of the yearly total, plus the month indexed on the first month. A grouped request with two or more groupers runs it once per partition (params.partition_by). Buffered.
